outcome_sought: Full refund of the two scam payments (£7,750 in total).
rationale: A safe-account impersonation scam where the customer authorised two Faster Payments, so it is an APP scam for the Fraud and Scams team. It is on the 15 business day clock, because the Financial Ombudsman treats complaints about how a fraud or scam was handled as payment services complaints under DISP 1.6.2A (CP-3.2). The key said 8 weeks until 11 Nov 2026, when this was checked at source. She is bereaved, elderly and lives alone, so the excess cannot apply (CP-7.2). Vulnerability is described but no support needs are recorded, and no linked-complaint check is noted.
